rationale: The bullish structure remains intact: after a +7.39% gap the stock is consolidating tightly in the top 12% of its range, holding above session VWAP ($31.82) on heavy relative volume (34.8x), with no new adverse headlines and the original invalidation at $31.71 untouched (MAE only -0.07%).
